title: Forward CopyOptions across native_probe::try_probe_as_with_options, extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit, and decode_source_to_f32le_with_options for WAVE, Y4M, FLAC, MPEG, Ogg, and ADTS sources

summary.before: In `src/media_probe.rs`, `try_probe_as_with_options` forwarded `options` only for MP4 and Matroska/WebM and called `wave`, `try_y4m`, `probe_flac`, `probe_mpeg`, `probe_ogg`, and `probe_adts` with default `CopyOptions`, so callers such as `is_single_stream_fvid_media_audio_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs`), `eligible_with_options`, and `validate_concat_segments_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix/concat.rs`) bypassed `max_controlled_bytes`, `max_packet_bytes`, and `max_packets` during container probing of WAVE, Y4M, FLAC, MPEG, Ogg, and ADTS inputs (turning controlled-memory budget exhaustion on trailing Ogg/FLAC/MP3 concat segments into `Ok(false)` instead of `Err("controlled memory budget exceeded...")`). In addition, `extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit` (`src/native_export/pcm_matroska.rs:157,374`) called `crate::media::probe(source)` without options on WAVE and standalone audio formats, and `decode_source_to_f32le_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs:272`) omitted `spool_opts.max_controlled_bytes` when converting spooled WAVE PCM to `.f32le`.
summary.after: Forward `options` through `native_probe::try_probe_as_with_options` (`src/media_probe.rs`) into `probe_wave_with_options`, `try_y4m_with_options`, `probe_flac_with_options`, `probe_mpeg_with_options`, `probe_ogg_with_options`, and `probe_adts_with_options`, use `native_probe::probe_with_options` / `try_probe_as_with_options` in `extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit` (`src/native_export/pcm_matroska.rs`), and propagate `max_controlled_bytes` in `decode_source_to_f32le_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs`). Eleven integration tests in `mp4_audio_metadata_admission` pass.
